instruction: I placed an order for lunch meeting with some of my coworkers in office today. I had sent out an email yesterday to them asking for individual orders, and everyone involved responded with their chosen food item and its base price. The tip was was 25% on the food cost, and delivery fee was $12. Unlike individual orders, the tip and delivery fee are to be equally shared among all, including me. Make all the necessary (public) venmo requests with a description note, "Order for Lunch Meeting".

import re
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# Parse the lunch meeting order email thread to extract coworker base prices
thread_id = 47820
susan_email = 'susanmiller@gmail.com'

thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=gmail_login['access_token'])

coworker_prices = []  # (email, base_price_decimal)
for msg in thread.get('emails', []):
    sender = msg['sender']['email']
    if sender.lower() == susan_email.lower():
        continue
    body = msg.get('body','')
    m = re.search(r'for\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', body)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f'Could not parse price from body for sender {sender}: {body}')
    price = Decimal(m.group(1))
    coworker_prices.append((sender, price))

print('coworker_prices', coworker_prices)
print('count', len(coworker_prices))

food_cost = sum(p for _, p in coworker_prices)

tip = (food_cost * Decimal('0.25'))
delivery = Decimal('12')
total_fees = tip + delivery

N_total = Decimal(len(coworker_prices) + 1)  # include Susan for fee sharing
fee_share = (total_fees / N_total).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

owed = []
for email, base_price in coworker_prices:
    amt = (base_price + fee_share).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    owed.append((email, amt))

print('food_cost', food_cost)
print('tip', tip)
print('delivery', delivery)
print('total_fees', total_fees)
print('fee_share', fee_share)
print('owed', owed)
